<section class="hero wrap">
<div class="hero-copy">
A LIVE, HANDS-ON WORKSHOP SERIES
A digital presence that reflects your ambition.

Feel confident sending someone your link. We’ll build a website that makes your expertise clear and helps the right people see the value you bring. You’ll use AI throughout and learn how to keep developing it yourself.

For solopreneurs and professionals who want a digital presence that reflects their expertise and ambition—whether you’re growing a business, exploring your next role, or making room for what comes next.

December 2026 kickoff · Prework in November
Founding fee: $1,250 · Bring a buddy: $1,000 for you
<div class="hero-art" aria-label="Ariba Jahan’s website, brand book, and custom CMS, examples of what you will learn to build">
● ● ●aribajahan.com

YOUR BRAND BOOK
MAKE IT
YOUR OWN.
TYPE / COLOR / COMPONENTS / MOTION
YOUR CUSTOM CMSYOUR CONTENT. YOUR CONTROLS.
Built by Ariba Jahan. The process is what you’ll learn.
</section>

A presence that matches your ambitions

Make the value of your work clear to the people you want to reach, with room for where you want to go next.

Executive experience, direct feedback

Learn with Ariba Jahan, whose work spans product, design, and digital experiences for major brands. Get her feedback on the decisions behind your own site.

A finished website you own

Build with your real work and content, publish on your domain, and learn how to keep developing the site yourself.
<section class="outputs wrap section" id="outputs">

What you’ll build

When someone arrives from a referral, LinkedIn, or a talk, your site should help them understand your work, see why it matters, and take the next step.
<div class="output-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Explore workshop outputs">
<div class="output-panel" role="tabpanel" id="panel-site" aria-labelledby="tab-site" tabindex="0">

Who needs to understand what you do? What should they see first? We’ll work out what belongs on each page, then design and build it around your expertise and the work you want to show.

Design for desktop and mobile. Learn how navigation, images, content order, and interactions need to adapt to the screen someone is using.

You own the code and content, with the ability to move hosts.

DESKTOP
MOBILE

ONE WEBSITE, DESIGNED FOR BOTH.
<div class="output-panel" role="tabpanel" id="panel-brand" aria-labelledby="tab-brand" tabindex="0" hidden>

Create a visual language you love, then build the system that keeps it consistent. Bring your typography, colors, imagery, and layouts into a brand book you and your AI can use as you build.

Keep it consistent across your site and future materials, and evolve the system as your work grows.
<div class="output-panel" role="tabpanel" id="panel-cms" aria-labelledby="tab-cms" tabindex="0" hidden>

Build the controls for the parts of your site you want to update yourself. Start with your everyday content, then learn how to make more of your site editable as your needs change.

  • Your content: copy, projects, case studies, and testimonials.
  • Your media library: upload, organize, and reuse images across your site.
  • Your SEO settings: page titles, descriptions, URLs, and image alt text.
  • Your share previews: the title, description, and image supplied when a link is shared.
  • Your site controls: choose which links, calls to action, and page sections you want to manage.

Use your CMS for everyday updates. Work with your AI coding agent to add a feature or make another part of the site editable.
Ariba Jahan’s CMS. You’ll build a simpler version around your own content.
</section>

The workshop series

I’m keeping this group intentionally small so you can ask me questions directly and get feedback on your own site. I’ll demonstrate each step, then we’ll spend time building and working through your decisions together.
<div class="session-list">

01Set the foundationWORKSPACE + SITE PLAN+

Set up your local AI workspace: project folders, reference files, and instructions the AI can use across sessions. Decide who the site serves, what they need to understand about your value, and the action you want them to take. Use that to decide which pages you need and the job of each page.

You leave with: a working project folder, site brief, page map, and content outline.

02Find your design directionDESIGN + BRAND BOOK+

Explore references and distinct directions in Claude Design using your own copy. Choose how to express your expertise and personality while keeping the visitor’s next step clear. Make deliberate choices about type, color, imagery, and layout, then document them in a brand book. Turn recurring design instructions into a reusable skill.

You leave with: your chosen design direction and a reusable visual reference.

03Build your homepageWORKING WEBSITE+

Move the design into Claude Code or Codex. Build the homepage and design its desktop and mobile layouts. Adapt navigation, image crops, section order, and interactions for each screen; test on your phone and practice giving the AI specific feedback. Extend those patterns to your remaining pages between sessions.

You leave with: a working homepage and a repeatable way to build the rest.

04Make it yours to updateCUSTOM CONTENT STUDIO+

Build on a prepared CMS foundation. Choose the content fields and controls you need. Connect the editor to your copy, images, projects, testimonials, and page-level SEO settings. Practice adding a case study and checking the result before publishing.

You leave with: an editor configured for your site and a tested content update.

05Put it into the worldLIVE ON YOUR DOMAIN+

Check mobile layouts, links, contact routes, and accessibility basics. Set page titles, descriptions, and social-sharing images. Connect your own Google Analytics account and verify a visit. Connect your domain, publish, and practice making another change and restoring an earlier version. Create a slash command for a repeatable task, such as checking a page before publishing.

You leave with: a live site and a way to keep it current.

06Office hours & site reviewsHELP WITH YOUR NEXT STEP+

Bring questions from finishing and using your site. Get direct help, see what others built, and work through remaining issues. Each participant also gets a bookable 30-minute individual session with Ariba Jahan.

Bring: your site, the change you want to make, or the thing you’re stuck on.

Homework after every working session. Apply what we covered to your own site, then bring that work into the next session for feedback and the next build step. Bring your existing copy, work samples, and images to the series; we’ll shape them as we build.
</section>

The tools

These are the tools I used to build my site. We’ll work through what each one does and how to use them together, from exploring a design to publishing a change.

01 / DESIGN

Claude Design

Explore visual directions and develop your brand book.

02 / BUILD

Claude Code or Codex

Work with an AI coding agent on files on your computer.

Practice giving instructions and reviewing the result.
03 / WEBSITE

Next.js + React

Build the pages and components that make up your site.

04 / VERSION + PUBLISH

GitHub + Vercel

Keep a history of changes and publish on your own domain.

Designing your AI workspace

Project context

Organize your files and write instructions so the AI can refer to your brief, voice, and design choices as you build.

Reusable skills

Package instructions for work you do repeatedly, such as writing a project page in your voice or following your brand book.

Slash commands

Create shortcuts for repeatable workflows, such as reviewing a page before publishing. Use and refine them on your own project.

Build with me.

Ariba Jahan

I’ve led product, innovation, and digital experience work at the Ad Council and Anomaly. My work spans product strategy, experience design, and helping people put emerging technology into practice. When I rebuilt aribajahan.com with AI, I kept a record of the brief, the design options, and the decisions I changed as I built.

I’m bringing that practice into this workshop series. We’ll work on how someone discovering your work understands your value, what helps them trust you, and how your digital presence supports their decision. I’ll help you make those choices, direct the AI, and judge what it builds.

Join the founding series

This first series is being offered privately, with an intentionally small group. Prework arrives in November so you can gather your content and get your tools ready before we build together.

  • Website feedback
  • Offer productization and strategy
  • Custom site feature planning

Additional to the 30-minute individual session included in the series.

Exact dates and enrollment details coming soon. Tool subscriptions, domain, and hosting costs are separate.

Before you join

Who is this for?+

For solopreneurs and professionals who want a digital presence that reflects their expertise and ambition—whether you’re growing a business, exploring your next role, or making room for what comes next.

How is this different from other courses?+

This series brings positioning, design, and AI building together around your own work. We start with the value you provide, the people you want to reach, and what they need to understand before working with you. You’ll set up a local AI workspace, build a site that reflects those decisions, and create a CMS you can keep updating as your work evolves.

I bring my background in customer experience, product, and design into the room. The group is intentionally small so you can ask me questions directly. I’ll review what you’re making across the sessions, help you work through decisions, and give you direct feedback as you make revisions. We’ll work on how your digital presence represents your value and how it helps people decide to work with you.

Do I need to have used these tools before?+

No. You’ll need a computer and a paid Claude account. We’ll set up your workspace together. Allow time between sessions to work on your site.

What do I need, and will you help me set it up?+

I’ll send you prework covering the accounts, downloads, and files to gather. You’ll need a computer and a paid Claude account. We’ll set up your local AI workspace together, then work through GitHub, hosting, and connecting your domain as we build.

I’ll explain what each tool does and guide you through the setup. Your site will use Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS with your AI coding agent. Tool subscriptions, your domain, and hosting are separate from the workshop fee; I’ll make those requirements and costs clear before enrollment.

What can I update afterward?+

Use your CMS to edit copy, manage your media library, add projects or case studies, manage testimonials, and update SEO settings. Connect your own Google Analytics account to understand visits to your site. For layout changes or new features, work with your AI coding agent, check the result, and publish the change.

When does it run, and what does it cost?+

The series kicks off in December 2026, with prework sent in November. The founding fee is $1,250, or $1,000 for you when you bring a buddy who pays $1,250. Exact dates, session length, and enrollment details are being finalized. Tool subscriptions, hosting, and your domain may carry separate costs; those requirements will be made clear before enrollment.

Will I own my website?+

Yes. You own the code and content, and your domain and hosting accounts are yours. Once your new site is live and your domain is connected, you can finally cancel that Squarespace website subscription. You’ll still need a domain and hosting for your new site.

Build a presence you own and feel proud to share.

Own your code and content. Keep developing your site as your work evolves.

December kickoff · November prework.

If you have any other questions, email Ariba Jahan.
